_readme: Screenshots for the site's /changelog page, keyed by release (<product>@<version>, product vscode or speckit) then by the media id a highlight names in its <!-- area: …; pr: …; media: … --> comment. file is a repo-relative PNG under apps/website/public/ or docs/screenshots/generated/. alt is required. highlight is optional, in the image's own pixels, and is drawn over the image by the page. The site build fails on an unknown id, a missing alt or file, an unused shot, or a key that matches no release. See apps/website/src/components/changelog/releaseMedia.ts.

move-to-phase.alt: A node panel in the Pipeline Builder with Move to phase… open, listing gather, author and classify, each marked Joins the end of it.
move-to-phase.caption: Move to phase… lists the phases the node is not in.

side-panel.alt: The Pipeline Builder docked in a narrow side panel, with the specify step's phases and nodes stacked above the plan step.
side-panel.caption: In a side panel the steps stack one under the next.

move-hook.alt: The implement step in the Pipeline Builder, with an npm test command hook being dragged into the after slot of Mark the spec complete, a green line marking where it will land.
move-hook.caption: Drop a hook where it should run; the green line shows where it lands.

run-overview.alt: The Overview of a completed spec, with the run overview row reading Specify 5m 40s, Plan 7m 36s, Tasks 3m 25s and Implement 34m 45s, and 51m 28s active.
run-overview.caption: Each step is timed to its own finish, and the total is active time.

removed-doc.alt: The spec viewer showing the Specification under a notice that reads Plan was moved or deleted, so Specification is showing.
removed-doc.caption: A removed document is named, not skipped over in silence.

copilot-board.alt: The SpecKit Companion board in the GitHub Copilot app: the list of specs on the left, and Persist Todos open on the right with its four finished steps and a This spec is finished card.
copilot-board.caption: Every spec with its pipeline and the next thing to do.

copilot-tasks.alt: The Copilot app board with a spec in Implementing, its Tasks tab open at 3 of 6, showing Phase 1 Setup with a checked task and the files it touched.
copilot-tasks.caption: Task progress updates live as the agent works.

copilot-new-spec.alt: The Copilot app board's New spec form, with Companion, Spec Kit and Auto workflow choices above a box to describe the feature and a Specify button.
copilot-new-spec.caption: New spec asks for a workflow, the same way VS Code does.

pipeline-builder.alt: The Pipeline Builder panel, showing the specify and plan steps as columns of phases and nodes with an attached hook.
pipeline-builder.caption: The pipeline your project actually runs, step by step.

overview-dossier.alt: The spec viewer Overview, annotated: intent, expectations, verified checks, decisions and coverage.
overview-dossier.caption: What a future session needs, in the order it needs it.
